hero.headline: Cut to You. Not Off the Rack.
hero.subhead: De Fabiano has built bespoke suits, shirts, and formalwear on Sukhumvit Road since 2006. Every piece starts with your measurements, not a size chart.

about.title: About De Fabiano
body: Founded in 2006 by three brothers, De Fabiano Bespoke has established itself as a leading name in bespoke fashion in Bangkok. With a passion for blending traditional craftsmanship and modern design, we deliver exceptional quality and personalized service in every garment we create.

We work in wool, cotton, silk, and linen from a curated cloth library, with structured canvas construction options, including full-canvas configurations, for enhanced longevity and shape retention. Every client receives a uniquely drafted pattern, not an adjusted house block.
We regularly work with international clients: measurements and fittings are taken in person, and finished garments are shipped once complete, with tracking provided where available.

faq.q: Where can I find the best custom suit in Sukhumvit, Bangkok?
faq.a: We're located at 762/12 Sukhumvit Road, Khlong Tan, Khlong Toei, Bangkok 10110, conveniently accessible from Phrom Phong and Thonglor BTS. We specialize in full bespoke and made-to-measure suits with personalized craftsmanship.

faq.q: How long does it take to make a custom suit in Bangkok?
faq.a: Our standard turnaround is typically 4-6 days, depending on fabric availability and construction method. Rush service may be available on request, confirm timelines before ordering.

faq.q: How many fittings are required for a custom suit?
faq.a: Most bespoke or made-to-measure suits require an initial measurement session, at least one fitting, and a final adjustment fitting if needed. More complex garments may require additional fittings.

faq.q: Is a deposit required for custom tailoring?
faq.a: Yes, a deposit of 50% or more is required to begin production, since fabric is ordered and cut specifically for the client. Custom garments are made-to-order and cannot be resold.

Once fabric is cut and construction begins, the garment is uniquely made for your measurements and design choices. Because of this personalization, custom orders are generally non-refundable, though we ensure proper fit adjustment before delivery.

faq.q: Can I order while visiting Bangkok and have it shipped later?
faq.a: Yes. We take measurements during your visit, complete fittings within your stay where time allows, and ship final garments internationally. Shipping fees and customs duties may apply.
